name: @lachimere/harness-engineering
description: Harness-as-code platform for AI coding agents.

scripts.build: bun -e "import { rm } from 'node:fs/promises'; await rm('./dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && bun build ./src/index.ts --target node --outfile ./dist/index.js
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint
scripts.test:all: bun run check && bun run test:unit && bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e: bun run build && bun test tests/e2e --test-concurrency 1
scripts.test:unit: bun test tests/cli tests/schemas tests/unit-tests tests/ci-tests
